This is a duplicate of `DivInvMonoid.div_eq_mul_inv` ensuring that the types unfold better.

tsub_mul.{u} {α : Type u} [CanonicallyOrderedCommSemiring α] [Sub α] [OrderedSub α] [IsTotal α fun x x_1 => x ≤ x_1]
